# Where vendor/ comes from

Copied by `../vendor.sh` from a Firefox source checkout at commit `a8d334e3bde6e`
(directory `parser/html`). The files are generated from Java by Firefox's own translator (`parser/html/java/translator`)
and are under the Mozilla Public License 2.0; the license headers are kept in the files.

`vendor.sh` changes them in two scripted ways only:
- the DOM element factory function names in the element-name table (`NS_NewHTMLXxxElement` and the like) become `nullptr`,
  and `NS_NewCustomElement` becomes `MRT_CUSTOM_ELEMENT`;
- `#include` lines for Firefox-only headers (`nsContentUtils.h`, `nsHtml5Parser.h`, `nsHtml5StreamParser.h`, ...) are deleted.

The tokenizer and tree-builder glue files that Firefox provides as "supplements" are replaced by ours in `../shim/`.
`../shim/nsGkAtomList.h` is the static atom list generated by a Firefox build of the same commit (`obj-hib/dist/include`).
